final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image, with no border or frame. Build the composition from a deep, near-black indigo ground interrupted by dense, restless bands of electric cyan, hot coral, pale cream, and sharp acid yellow. Let broad, rough brushstrokes collide with fine scratches, translucent washes, scraped-back layers, and small bursts of stippled pigment. Gather the most intense color and texture into an off-center knot, then pull loose gestures outward until they thin into quiet, dark space. Balance compression and release, abrupt contrast and soft bleed, repetition and interruption; make the surface feel layered, searching, and alive with uncertain rhythm. Keep it entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, gallery, or surrounding setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
